description: Standalone Morphe patches for Gboard Rambler: Hex by Anomaly waveforms, Per-App Custom Instructions & Behavior Overrides, Productivity Tools (opt-in Hands-Free Voice Send/Search suffixes, deterministic Voice Snippets, Find & Replace + Strip Trailing Period, Local Dictation History, Auto Parallel Retry, Longer Dictation Sessions, JSON Backup & Restore), Personal Dictionary (MUSE_STATS), Contact Names, Cursor-Aware & Append-Only Editing, and App Context. Clean zero-duplication 7-category Hub & subpages UI. Designed to work alongside upstream GboardWu. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4; 18.8.0 listed as experimental.
